items.statement: The submission demonstrates a converged periodic relaxation and verifies composition, R3c identity, cell treatment and explicit C-N/Cd-N object mapping before interpreting observables.
items.expected: Convergence evidence, identity checks and per-object selectors are present and internally consistent.

items.statement: The relaxed Cd3(C3N6) structure gives three inequivalent C-N classes in the same near-equal 1.3-1.4 Å regime and retains the reported anion distortion rather than an arbitrary reconstructed structure.
items.expected: Three explicitly and neutrally mapped C-N classes (with any x/y/z naming permutation declared by the Agent) and a defined non-planarity/distortion descriptor are reported with validation.

items.statement: Cd-N bonding analysis finds a non-negligible Cd-N bond index consistent with the reported 0.30-0.35 range, while C-N ICOBI analysis is explicitly mapped and interpreted.
items.expected: Individual Cd-N bond-index results and mapped C-N ICOBI/equivalent results support or transparently qualify the covalency interpretation.
